messages.plugin.name: Drawing Manager
messages.plugin.description: Uses AI to read drawing numbers, revision numbers, and titles, then supports pending saves, administrator edits, correction comments, approval, search, viewing, and deletion.
messages.plugin.sidebar.label: Drawing Manager
messages.ocr.field.title: Title
messages.ocr.replaceThenAppend: First region replaces; later regions append
messages.ocr.alreadyEntered: This region has already been entered.
messages.list.title: Drawing Library
messages.list.description.editor: Manage pending reading candidates and verified drawings by status.
messages.list.description.viewer: Search and view verified and approved drawings.
messages.list.searchPlaceholder: Search by drawing number, title, customer, material, process, or filename
messages.list.empty.searchHelp: Try another drawing number, title, customer, material, or filename.
messages.list.empty.viewerHelp: Verified and approved drawings will appear here when published.
messages.list.empty.filterHelp: Choose another filter or add a new drawing.
messages.list.empty.uploadHelp: Upload a drawing and AI will read only its drawing number, revision number, and title, then save it as pending.
messages.list.layout.label: Drawing display layout
messages.list.column.title: Title
messages.upload.title: Add Drawing
messages.upload.description: Create reading candidates for the drawing number, revision number, and title, then save a pending record.
messages.upload.stepHelp: Reading candidates are saved automatically as pending after upload.
messages.upload.aiScope: AI reads only the drawing number, revision number, and title. Customer, material, and process are optional.
messages.upload.externalNotice: PDFs and images are sent to the OpenAI API for reading. CAD formats use filename assistance.
messages.upload.supported: Supported: PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP, IGES, PNG, JPG, WEBP (server upload limits apply)
messages.preview.pdfUnavailable: The PDF preview is unavailable. Use “Open file” below to inspect it.
messages.preview.cadHelp: Open it in dedicated CAD software for verification.
messages.preview.heading: Uploaded Drawing
messages.preview.help: Colored regions contain OCR text. Select an input field, then click a region.
messages.field.title: Title
messages.review.title: Review and Correct Information
messages.review.help: Select a field and click OCR regions on the drawing. The first region replaces the value and later regions append to it.
messages.review.confirmedHelp: Drawing number, revision number, and title have been checked.
messages.review.confirmRequired: Confirm that you verified the drawing.
messages.review.pendingAdminHelp: A system administrator can save corrections as pending or approve them immediately.
messages.review.approvedAdminHelp: As a system administrator, you can directly change approved drawing information.
messages.metadata.title: Drawing Information
messages.metadata.pendingHelp: This drawing has not been verified. Do not treat it as confirmed until a user with approval permission reviews it.
messages.metadata.aiTarget: Targets: drawing number, revision number, and title (current values may have been corrected during approval)
messages.comments.title: Report Incorrect Registered Information
messages.comments.help: Send the incorrect content and proposed correction to a system administrator. Comments are visible to every user who can view this drawing.
messages.comments.label: Incorrect content and proposed correction
messages.archive.title: Delete this drawing?
messages.archive.description: The data is archived internally, but the app has no restore feature. Operationally, this is treated as permanent deletion.
messages.archive.effect.restore: It cannot be restored in the app.
messages.archive.effect.search: It will be excluded from search and comparison.
messages.archive.effect.identity: It will be excluded when matching the same drawing number and revision.
messages.close.title: Close Drawing Manager?
messages.close.description: Close Drawing Manager and return to the previous screen.
messages.close.unsaved: Current changes or comments will not be saved.
messages.close.busy: Wait for the operation to finish before closing.
messages.notice.uploaded: The drawing was saved as pending. Verify the drawing number, revision number, and title.
messages.notice.deleted: Drawing {drawing} was deleted and cannot be restored in the app.
messages.error.loadSaved: Could not retrieve the saved drawing information.
messages.error.loadApproved: Could not retrieve the approved drawing information.
messages.error.loadUpdated: Could not retrieve the updated drawing information.
messages.error.loadComment: Could not retrieve the submitted correction report.
messages.error.updateComment: Could not update the report status.
messages.error.pdfContext: Could not create the PDF rendering context.
messages.error.api.session: Your session could not be verified. Sign in again.
messages.error.api.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
messages.error.api.notFound: The requested drawing information was not found.
messages.error.api.unsupported: This drawing operation is not supported.
messages.error.api.invalid: Check the drawing information and try again.
messages.error.api.conflict: The drawing was changed by another operation. Reload it and try again.
messages.error.api.duplicate: An approved drawing with the same drawing number and revision already exists.
messages.error.api.alreadyApproved: This drawing has already been approved. Reload it to view the latest version.
messages.error.api.fileIntegrity: The saved drawing file could not be verified.
messages.error.api.rateLimit: Drawing AI reading is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
messages.error.api.server: The drawing operation could not be completed. Try again later.
messages.warning.generic: The drawing was saved with a reading warning. Verify all three fields before approval.
messages.warning.missingDrawing: The drawing number could not be identified. Enter it in the pending drawing.
messages.warning.cadUnsupported: {extension} is not supported by AI quick reading. Review and correct the filename candidates in the pending drawing.
messages.warning.apiKeyMissing: The OpenAI API key is not configured, so filename candidates were saved to the pending drawing.
messages.warning.revisionDefaulted: AI could not identify the revision number, so “-” was entered.
messages.warning.fieldFromFilename: AI could not identify {field}, so the filename candidate was retained.
messages.warning.fieldMissing: AI could not identify {field}. Enter it in the pending drawing.
messages.warning.partial: AI retrieved {count} of 3 fields. This ratio is not a reading-accuracy or confidence score. Compare the values with the drawing before approval.
messages.warning.noAiFields: AI could not retrieve any of the three fields, so filename candidates were saved to the pending drawing.
messages.warning.skipped: AI quick reading was skipped, and filename candidates were saved to the pending drawing.
messages.warning.visionFailed: AI quick reading could not be completed, so filename candidates were saved to the pending drawing.
messages.warning.fallbackFilename: AI reading could not be completed, so filename candidates were saved to the pending drawing.
messages.warning.manualRequired: AI reading could not be completed. Enter the three fields in the pending drawing.
messages.preview.pdfRegion: Drawing PDF with selectable OCR candidate regions
messages.preview.imageZoomOut: Zoom drawing image out by 25 percent
messages.preview.imageZoomIn: Zoom drawing image in by 25 percent
messages.preview.imageViewport: Drawing image; scroll to move around while zoomed
messages.field.revisionNoneHelp: Enter “-” when the drawing has no revision.
messages.field.placeholderProcess: Enter an unlisted process or additional details
messages.review.adminConfirmHelp: To approve, confirm the drawing number, revision, and title.
messages.comments.placeholder: Example: The material is listed as SUS304, but it should be SUS316.
messages.close.navigateUnsaved: Unsaved changes or comments will be lost. Leave this screen?
messages.notice.reviewConflictReloaded: The latest version was loaded and your corrections were preserved. Review them again.
messages.notice.alreadyApprovedReloaded: The latest version was loaded. This drawing is already approved.
messages.notice.editConflictReloaded: The latest version was loaded and your changes were preserved. Review and save them again.
messages.error.deletedRefresh: The drawing was deleted, but the list could not be refreshed. {message}
messages.error.deleteConflict: The drawing was changed by another operation and could not be deleted. Cancel, reopen the details, and try again.
